title: Han Lie's Layout
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone thought Chen Ji had been thoroughly trampled into the dust, an ancient voice rang out from the Void: 'Wait—' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested at this moment, yet within his familiar eyes, Chen Ji caught a chill that shouldn't have been there.

text.content:
In the Council Hall of Tianqing Sect, sandalwood incense curled through the air, but couldn't suppress the gunpowder smell permeating the atmosphere. Chen Ji stood in the most inconspicuous corner of the hall, his face wearing its usual mask of dullness—as if today's events had nothing to do with him. However, his fingertips were gently caressing the yellowed fragment hidden in his sleeve, the Tianji Record growing faintly warm in his palm.

Three days. The characters on that secret letter still burned in his mind. 'Chen Nian has been relocated, do not search.' A mere six characters had torn apart the chess game he had meticulously set up over several months. And more ironically, just as he was scrambling to respond, this idiot Han Lie chose this exact moment to make his move.

dialogue.content: Elders of the sect, today Xuanwu Sect has come to settle an old score with Tianqing Sect!

text.content:
Han Lie, clad in dark battle robes, stood in the center of the hall, his presence as profound and deep as an abyss. Thirty years ago, he had been merely a youth suffocated by Chen Ji's father, yet now he had become Xuanwu Sect's number one genius, his cultivation skills incredibly profound. His gaze swept across the crowd before settling on Chen Ji, a playful smile curling at his lips.

'Chen Ji, do you remember the marriage contract from thirty years ago?' His voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. 'I have come today on behalf of Xuanwu Sect to seek justice.' With that, he pulled out a jade slip from his sleeve and casually tossed it into the air.

The jade slip exploded mid-air, transforming into a massive luminous screen. On the screen, Chen Ji was shown in secret conversation with a shadowy figure surrounded by dense demonic energy—the telltale sign of the Holy Sect's signature technique. Beneath the image, the precise time and location were clearly marked.

'Outer Disciple Chen Ji, colluding with the Demonic Path, evidence is conclusive!' Han Lie thundered. 'How can such a traitor remain in Tianqing Sect, let alone hold the title of 'First Among Outer Disciples'!'

An uproar immediately filled the hall. Those fellow disciples who had previously greeted Chen Ji with friendly smiles now wore completely changed expressions, as if he were some catastrophic disaster. The spectacle of everyone turning against a person played out perfectly in this grand hall.

'I knew something was off about him from the start!' an Inner Disciple was the first to jump out and speak. 'How could atrash possibly cultivate so fast? Obviously he took the demonic path!'

'Tch! I actually admired him as a real man, turns out he's a two-faced snake!'

Chen Ji gazed at the scene on the screen, a cold glint flickering in the depths of his eyes.

This footage was indeed authentic—it was the scene of his secret meeting with Ye Qing three months prior. But Han Lie obtaining this record was more than enough proof that someone inside Tianqing Sect was gathering intelligence for him. Who? Ling Yuan? Or some other force lurking in the shadows?

He didn't rush to defend himself. The benefit of being atrash was that no one expected you to immediately retort. And he needed this moment of silence to deduce how many more moves Han Lie had prepared.

Han Lie strode slowly toward Chen Ji, each step heavy, as if measuring the territory of his impending victory. 'Back then, my son was engaged to your Chen family, primarily because I valued a certain potential hidden within the Chen bloodline.' His voice suddenly dropped, audible only to those present. 'Unfortunately, your good-for-nothing father died too early, and the son he left behind is also hopeless waste. The engagement? Better to退婚 it—saves us from tarnishing Xuanwu Sect's reputation.'

Here he suddenly burst out laughing, that smile carrying three parts satisfaction and seven parts viciousness. 'However, I have another piece of good news to share with everyone today—the marriage contract from thirty years ago was a trap I set from the very beginning.' He spread his arms wide, as if embracing the entire hall. 'Hidden within the Chen bloodline is the key to opening a certain secret realm. I merely used the marriage contract as a pretext to get close to the Chen family and investigate the secrets of that bloodline power.'

'Your so-called 'engagement退婚'? It's simply because I discovered you're not some genius at all, but a completetrash! What qualifications does atrash have to marry the daughter of Xuanwu Sect?'

choice.prompt: Han Lie publicly humiliated Chen Ji and exposed the conspiracy from thirty years ago. Should he endure and lie low while waiting for the right moment, or openly resist and teach this idiot a lesson?

choices.description: Continue playing thetrash, let Han Lie become so complacent that he reveals more weaknesses, while secretly gathering evidence of his collusion with the Holy Sect.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily lose the title of First Among Outer Disciples and all privileges
choices.visible_reward: Han Lie exposes more of his hand, laying the groundwork for a later counterattack
choices.risk_hint: The risk is relatively low, but he may be stripped of more resources

text.content:
Chen Ji slightly lowered his head, his shoulders trembling gently—the trembling that Han Lie interpreted as fear, but in reality he was using the Tianji Record to rapidly calculate how the situation would change next.

'What, scared?' Han Lie laughed loudly. 'If you knew this day would come, why didn't you just accept your fate earlier! Someone, strip Chen Ji of his title as First Among Outer Disciples, revoke all his privileges!'

choices.description: Stop hiding, directly expose Han Lie's collusion with the Holy Sect, and let this idiot witness what true strategic mastery looks like.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal part of his strength, possibly attracting attention from higher powers
choices.visible_reward: Give Han Lie public humiliation, temporarily stabilizing the situation
choices.risk_hint: The risk is relatively high, but the satisfaction is immediate

text.content:
Just as Han Lie was about to announce the final verdict, Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, the corner of his mouth actually curving into a meaningful smile. That smile made Han Lie inexplicably apprehensive, as if being stared at by some ancient fierce beast.

'Mr. Han,' his voice was unusually calm, 'are you finished speaking?'

Yet Chen Ji still didn't speak. He only slowly raised his head, gazing at Han Lie with those seemingly turbid eyes. That gaze was eerily calm, as if looking at a clown performing on stage.

Han Lie frowned, inexplicably feeling a surge of unease. But he didn't dwell on it, simply assuming thetrash was putting up a last-ditch stubborn front. 'What, still not confessing?' His voice suddenly rose several octaves. 'The evidence is conclusive—what else do you have to say?'

"Han Lie stood with hands behind his back, his tone brimming with condescending arrogance. 'Kneel down. In front of everyone here, admit that you colluded with the Demonic Path and defiled the marriage pact. I might consider... letting you die with some dignity.' When he said the word 'die,' it was as casual as discussing today's weather.

The atmosphere within the great hall was oppressively heavy. No one spoke up for Chen Ji—or rather, no one dared to step forward at this moment. After all, behind Han Lie stood the Xuanwu Sect and... something even more terrifying."

Just then, commotion erupted outside the hall. A disciple rushed in, fell to his knees with a panic-stricken expression: 'Report—! Sect Master Ling Yuan has ordered: effective immediately, Chen Ji is stripped of his title as Outer Disciple Number One, his cave dwelling, training quota, and all sect resources!'

Upon hearing this, a satisfied smile spread across Han Lie's face. Ling Yuan，果然配合默契. He turned to Chen Ji, about to say something, but saw that this 'waste's' mouth actually curved slightly upward.

dialogue.content: "Smiling? You actually still have the nerve to smile?"

text.content:
Han Lie was stunned. The scene he had anticipated—fear, despair, begging for mercy—none of it had materialized. Chen Ji's reaction completely exceeded his expectations.

"Do you think this can make me yield?" Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet clearly reached everyone's ears. "Senior Han, it seems you've forgotten one thing."

His gaze fell upon the suspended light screen. "This image of the Demonic Path cultivator—are you certain... this is the evidence you used to threaten me?"

choice.prompt: Chen Ji began his counterattack. Should he continue testing Han Lie's hidden cards, or launch a fatal strike directly?

choices.description: "Use ambiguous words to guide Han Lie into making mistakes, letting him expose more connections to the Holy Sect himself."
choices.visible_reward: "Han Lie might reveal more inside information"

text.content: Chen Ji smiled lightly. That smile appeared bitter to the crowd, yet ominous to Han Lie. "Senior Han, do you know who that Demonic Path cultivator is?" His voice was unhurried. "What if I told you... she has countless connections to the Holy Sect, and the Holy Sect has been secretly colluding with certain righteous sect powers?"

choices.description: "Directly expose evidence of Han Lie's collaboration with the Holy Sect, letting this fool understand what it means to shoot himself in the foot."
choices.visible_reward: "Publicly humiliate Han Lie, recover some reputation"

dialogue.content: "Han Lie, the one thing you shouldn't have done—the one thing you absolutely shouldn't have done—was to threaten me with this footage."

text.content:
Han Lie's expression shifted slightly, but quickly returned to normal. He stepped forward, looking down at Chen Ji from above. "Boy, I don't care what connection you have with the Demonic Path, nor what scheme you're hatching. After today, you'll just be a stray dog!"

He suddenly leaned close to Chen Ji's ear, lowering his voice: "Oh right, I forgot to tell you—your sister who's been missing for years, Chen Nian... I've seen her."

This sentence was like a basin of ice water poured over Chen Ji's heart. His pupils contracted sharply, but the next moment, calmness returned.

"Seen?" His voice was terrifyingly calm. "Where?"

Han Lie grinned triumphantly: "Want to know? Then see if you have the life to survive until that day." He straightened up and said loudly, "Everyone, today's matter is settled! This waste colluded with the Demonic Path, defiled the marriage pact, deceived the sect—his crimes are unforgivable!"

However, just as everyone thought the matter was settled, a strange gust of wind suddenly came from outside the hall. That wind wailed like weeping, or perhaps like an ancient sigh, scattering countless leaves across the sky. The candles in the hall flickered unstably, as if some terrifying existence was approaching.

An ancient and ethereal voice rang out from the Void—

"Wait."

Every gaze simultaneously turned toward the hall entrance. A hazy figure was slowly forming from the Void. Though but a remnant soul, it emanated a heart-quelling pressure.

dialogue.content: "I am Mo Xiansheng, Guardian of the Tianji Record."

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shadow stood in the hall, his gaze sweeping over those present, finally landing on Han Lie. That gaze carried an indescribable meaning—not hostility, not anger, but a near-compassionate scrutiny.

"Han Lie," his voice was soft, yet every word was clearly heard by everyone present, "are you certain... you want to make an enemy of the Tianji Record's inheritor at this moment?"

Han Lie's expression finally changed.

However, the moment Chen Ji saw Mo Xiansheng, a chill rose in his heart.

Something was wrong.

He knew this remnant soul too well. Through countless past exchanges, Mo Xiansheng had always maintained an otherworldly detachment—he would offer guidance, but never actively intervene in disputes; he would reveal Heavenly Secrets, but never take a stance.

But today, why had he appeared so directly to lend support?

What made Chen Ji even more alert was—the fleeting glance of... scrutiny in Mo Xiansheng's eyes when he looked at Chen Ji.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng suddenly appeared to lend support. Should one accept the Master's backing and continue the counterattack, or remain vigilant and observe this unusual action?

choices.description: Use Mo Xiansheng's pressure to completely suppress Han Lie, then seize the initiative.
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily defuse the crisis, but may fall into a bigger trap
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may bear a grudge

choices.description: Observe Mo Xiansheng's abnormal attitude without revealing any sign, secretly guard against possible betrayal.
choices.visible_reward: Discover Mo Xiansheng's abnormality, foreshadowing for subsequent chapters
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie may exploit the weakness

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his face wearing perfectly calibrated gratitude. But his spiritual sense quietly observed every fluctuation of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul. In that observation, he discovered something amiss—within that remnant soul, there was actually a faint, barely perceptible... Holy Sect aura?

Han Lie's expression flickered between阴晴不定. The title of Tianji Record Guardian—this name he had heard before, only never expected to encounter it here, in such a manner. Mo Xiansheng's pressure, though merely a remnant soul, was far beyond anything he could contend with. "Mo Senior," he said deeply, "Are you openly interfering in the private affairs between the Tianqing Sect and Xuanwu Sect?" Mo Xiansheng did not answer, only turning to look at Chen Ji, his gaze carrying a meaningful inquiry—as if saying: "What do you want to do?"

Chen Ji lowered his eyes, concealing all emotions within them. Mo Xiansheng's appearance was too suspicious, that faint trace of Holy Sect aura even more so. But at this moment, he could not show any abnormality. Atrash should have the appearance of atrash. "Master," he said respectfully, "Your disciple leaves everything to the Master's arrangements." The words fell, and the atmosphere in the hall subtly shifted. Han Lie did not know what relationship truly existed between Mo Xiansheng and Chen Ji, but he understood—today's matter could not be resolved peacefully.

Mo Xiansheng nodded, the remnant soul's phantom flickering slightly. He surveyed the hall, his voice aged yet authoritative: "The Tianji Record Guardian has the Tianji Record's rules. The matter of Chen Ji, this old one will personally report to the Eyes of Heavenly Dao." He paused, his gaze falling upon Han Lie: "As for Han Lie... this old one advises you—do not think that climbing to higher branches allows you to act arbitrarily. Some chess games are not at a level for someone like you to peer into." Han Lie's face was ashen, yet he dared not utter a word of rebuttal.

In the end, this impeachment assembly concluded in a bizarre atmosphere. Han Lie declared this matter would not end here, departing with his people in resentment. The other elders and disciples in the hall also dispersed, though their gazes toward Chen Ji grew complex. Some were awed, some puzzled, and some... pensive. When only Chen Ji and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul remained in the hall, Chen Ji finally raised his head,直视那双虚幻的眼眸.

dialogue.content: "Master, you just mentioned 'those behind'—did you mean the Holy Sect?"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: "Han Lie is merely a chess piece. Those truly setting the board, their ambition lies not in you, nor in the Tianqing Sect." His voice became ethereal, "They are searching for something—or rather, a person." Chen Ji's heart sank violently. "Chen Nian..." he murmured. Mo Xiansheng gave no answer, but that silence itself was the answer.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the turbulent waves in his heart. Mo Xiansheng's attitude was too detached, as if knowing everything yet deliberately maintaining distance. This reminded Chen Ji of the Tianji Record itself—that seemingly helpful fragment, was it truly only helping him? "Master," he suddenly spoke, "Your disciple has one question." Mo Xiansheng raised his eyes to look at him. "Why did you appear today?" Chen Ji's voice was very calm, calm to the point of being cold, "You said the Tianji Record's successor can only rely on oneself."

dialogue.content: Because you are not yet prepared to die.

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's words were tranquil as water, yet sent a chill down Chen Ji's spine. At first glance it sounded like concern, but upon deeper reflection carried a certain... examination. As if he were an artifact, not yet time to be discarded. "Your disciple... thanks Master for your gracious care." Chen Ji lowered his head, concealing the cold intent in his eyes. Mo Xiansheng seemed to sense something, sighing softly: "You have grown, and become suspicious. This is good, but also..." he paused, "A hidden danger." As the words fell, the remnant soul slowly dissipated, leaving only words echoing in the hall—"When Volume Five opens, come find me. Some things... it's time to tell you."

Chen Ji stood alone in the empty hall, the setting sun's remaining light filtering through the window lattice, casting a long shadow beneath his feet. Han Lie's schemes, Chen Nian's disappearance, Mo Xiansheng's abnormality—all clues intertwined, weaving a massive net he could not yet see through. And he stood at the net's center. "Interesting." he murmured, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his mouth, "All want to use me as a chess piece? Then let's see, in the end, who devours whom." He turned and walked out of the hall, his pace still slow, his bearing still humble—a completetrash, vanishing into the twilight.

Just as Chen Ji departed from the Council Hall, a slender figure stood beneath distant eaves, silently watching his retreating back. Su Qingyao's brow furrowed tightly. Everything that happened in the hall today was completely different from what she had anticipated. Chen Ji's relationship with the Demonic Path, Mo Xiansheng's appearance, Han Lie's狼狈... and those eyes of Chen Ji's, seemingly murky yet actually fathomlessly deep. "Chen Ji... just how many secrets are you still hiding?" she murmured to herself, a complex light flickering in her eyes. Having made a certain decision, she quietly followed after him.
